Name: Beriah, Son of Elpaal
Summary: Son of Elpaal and head of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:13: Son of Elpaal and head of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Beriah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
